subject: Why doesn't stat_summary() work when x is a factor?

messages.author: 56148d40b6509fff
messages.subject: Why doesn't stat_summary() work when x is a factor?
parts:
My question: Why does case 2 not behave like case 1?
 

Thanks,

 

Dave

 

library(ggplot2)
 

# case1:  stat_summary() connects the means when x is numeric:
c <- qplot(cyl, mpg, data=mtcars)
c + stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom='line')

 
# case2:  but stat_summary() doesn' work when x is a factor.  why??
c <- qplot(factor(cyl), mpg, data=mtcars)
c + stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom='line')
 
# case3:  However, this code with geom_line, works whether x is factor or numeric
c <- qplot(factor(cyl), mpg, data=mtcars)
# c <- qplot(cyl, mpg, data=mtcars)
c + geom_line(aes(group=1), stat='summary', fun.y='mean')

messages.subject: Re: Why doesn't stat_summary() work when x is a factor?

On 1/23/2012 7:01 AM, David Cooper wrote:
> My question: Why does case 2 not behave like case 1?
>
> Thanks,
>
> Dave
>
>
> library(ggplot2)
>
>
> # case1: stat_summary() connects the means when x is numeric:
> c<- qplot(cyl, mpg, data=mtcars)
> c + stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom='line')
>
> # case2: but stat_summary() doesn' work when x is a factor. why??
> c<- qplot(factor(cyl), mpg, data=mtcars)
> c + stat_summary(fun.y = mean, geom='line')
>
> # case3: However, this code with geom_line, works whether x is factor or
> numeric
> c<- qplot(factor(cyl), mpg, data=mtcars)
> # c<- qplot(cyl, mpg, data=mtcars)
> c + geom_line(aes(group=1), stat='summary', fun.y='mean')

You need the aes(group=1) to make it work across factors:

qplot(factor(cyl), mpg, data=mtcars) +
stat_summary(aes(group=1), fun.y = mean, geom='line')

Also, don't use c as a variable name; too much chance of causing
problems with the c function.
